items.title: Can AI automate AI R&D yet? InnovationEval early evidence points to 'No'
items.summary_en: Epoch introduces InnovationEval, a test of whether an AI can independently devise an ML innovation that matches a recent human-developed one it has not seen. Early evidence suggests current AI cannot yet do this.
